Subject: Intro + proposed Redwood demo windows

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We (SkyFinance Product + Infrastructure) are looking for a 60–75 minute walkthrough of Redwood's hosted + dedicated deployment options and how routing/fallback would work across regions. Attendees will include folks in US (NY), EU (Dublin/London), and APAC (Tokyo/Singapore).

Candidate weeks:
- Week of Apr 5 (note: EU has Easter bank holidays around Apr 2–5)
- Week of May 3 (we realize this overlaps Japanese Golden Week dates)
- Week of May 10 (preferred if we can make it work globally)

High-level ask: can you propose 2–3 time windows that try to keep a single live demo (no repeated recordings) while not forcing our APAC lead to join at 2:00 AM local?

Attached: brief context doc (light).

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Liam — thanks for the context and the proposed weeks. Ava and Karthik are copied to help cover APAC and EU windows.

High-level availability we can offer (60–75m):
- Option A: May 10 @ 16:00 GMT / May 11 01:00 JST (works for EU/US overlap; APAC very late)
- Option B: May 11 @ 09:00 PT / May 11 17:00 CET / May 12 01:00 JST (rotated so APAC joins late evening)
- Option C: May 12 @ 15:00 GMT / May 12 23:00 JST (later for APAC but earlier for EU)

Note on DST/overlap: the US moves clocks in mid-March (already passed) which shifts morning US/late-EU overlap by an hour vs. Q4 planning — we'll call out local times in the invite.

Before we lock anything, could you confirm:
- which APAC timezones specifically (Tokyo vs. Singapore)?
- is it critical that the APAC lead be present for the whole demo, or could they join the last 20 minutes for Q&A?

Attaching a lightweight demo agenda + a timezone availability .ics that contains the three options as tentative blocks.

Thanks,

Hi Dylan / Liam — quick note from the product side at SkyFinance.

APAC: our Tokyo lead (Hiro Tanaka) will be out for Golden Week May 3–5 and has very limited availability immediately after; ideally he'd be available for the live session but not if it falls in the small hours of his local time. Singapore folks are fine later evenings.

EU: several folks are taking April 2–6 for Easter and prefer not to schedule in that window.

If you can aim for the week of May 10, that would be best. We have a constraint that senior infra (NY) prefers demos earlier in their day (between 08:30–11:30 ET). That makes an optimal live overlap window roughly 13:30–17:00 GMT to get EU in afternoon and US in morning, APAC joining evening.

Propose: May 11 at 16:00 GMT (which is 11:00 ET / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST on May 12) — this keeps APAC at a late-but-joinable hour and avoids Golden Week.

Thanks — Priya
Director, Platform Product
SkyFinance
